description: This PHP source file generates an HTML page to display a detailed report of test plans with custom fields in the TestLink test management system. It initializes necessary configurations, retrieves linked custom fields for test plans, constructs a data table with custom field information, and renders the output using Smarty templates.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class (presumably defined in 'exttable.class.php') used to represent and handle external tables in HTML, supporting configuration of columns, sorting, and behaviors.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Constructs an external data table for displaying test case information along with linked custom fields within a specified test plan.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves parameters necessary for processing test plan data and custom fields, including test project and test plan IDs and names.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has the 'testplan_metrics' right on the project.
